review.summary: The change adds a strictly validated, optional Discord mention to DiscordOpsAlert, reserving room so the ping survives the 1800-character truncation, and documents the new env var in .env.example, both ops docs, and the changelog. The implementation handles the required edge cases (null/empty, integers, whitespace, @everyone/@here, newline and suffix injection) and ships comprehensive Pest tests covering valid, invalid, and truncation paths. No blocking issues, convention deviations, or security gaps were found, so it is approvable as is.
